lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Thanks for joining. Today we decide the launch date for the Hartmann pilot, and who owns what.

lines.speaker: Tom Becker
lines.text: The build is stable. I ran the soak test for two days and saw no crashes.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Great. So can we launch on the third of November, or is anything blocking us?

lines.speaker: Jonas Weber
lines.text: One thing. The Azure app registration is still pending, so Outlook calendars will not sync yet.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Can we launch with Google calendars only, and add Outlook in a patch?

lines.speaker: Jonas Weber
lines.text: Yes, that works. The tenant admin gave me a slot on Thursday, so Outlook can follow next week.

lines.speaker: Mei Lin
lines.text: From support, Hartmann asked for their pallet label format in the export.

lines.speaker: Tom Becker
lines.text: That is a small change. I can ship it before the launch.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Then we decide: launch on the third of November with Google only, and Outlook follows in a patch.

lines.speaker: Mei Lin
lines.text: Should we tell Hartmann about the Outlook delay before the launch?

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Yes. Mei, please send them a short note tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Tom Becker
lines.text: I will also write the rollback steps in the runbook, just in case.

lines.speaker: Jonas Weber
lines.text: And I will meet the tenant admin on Thursday and report back in the channel.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: One open question: who answers the support inbox during launch week?

lines.speaker: Mei Lin
lines.text: I can cover the mornings, but I need someone for the afternoons.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Let's park that. I will ask Sven and we come back to it on Friday.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Thanks everyone, that is all for today.
